# Arch-System Portal

> An oil & gas field operations portal built as a pnpm 9 monorepo (Turborepo).
> Single Next.js 16 app (`apps/portal`) + 16 shared packages. Department-based routing
> with Redis L1/L2 caching, Supabase Postgres, and edge auth via `proxy.ts`.

## Agent Policy (Required Reading)

- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): Canonical policy — commands, architecture, conventions, CI gates

## Architecture

- [docs/WAYFINDER.md](../docs/WAYFINDER.md): Structural index — concept → entry point → ADR
- [docs/architecture/](../docs/architecture/): ADRs and architecture references
- [apps/portal/CLAUDE.md](../apps/portal/CLAUDE.md): Portal-specific agent guidance

## Design System

- [docs/design-system/RULES.md](../docs/design-system/RULES.md): Enforceable visual contract
- [docs/design-system/SPEC.md](../docs/design-system/SPEC.md): Token specifications

## Key Source Files

- [apps/portal/src/proxy.ts](../apps/portal/src/proxy.ts): Edge auth + ACL (ALL requests pass through)
- [packages/acl/src/index.ts](../packages/acl/src/index.ts): Department slugs + roles (SSOT)
- [packages/contract/index.ts](../packages/contract/index.ts): Zod validation schemas
- [packages/redis/src/cache.ts](../packages/redis/src/cache.ts): L1/L2 cache API
- [packages/supabase/src/index.ts](../packages/supabase/src/index.ts): Database clients
